why: Yahoo Tech (Rick Broida) answers this with its own testing (TV runtime, recharge, weight), but its cap is $250 and camping is only touched on. That makes it one partial major-reviewer answer. The rest are niche spec/price sites with uncheckable testing claims, a manual and a general camping roundup. A new page could get in but would compete with Yahoo.
